## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and both Financials and Industrials are negative; leadership is narrow, concentrated in Energy and Materials, so Value/Cyclical style favored.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND. Materials next: DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, PPG (1W: +6.79% | 1M: -15.92%) RECOVERY. Utilities showing mild strength: CEG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: -6.70%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy, 2/5 Materials).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology weak: GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary lagging: DIS (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -12.44%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -11.44%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY, EOG (1W: +7.81% | 1M: +23.47%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentrated in Energy/Materials — Narrow (caution on concentration); style: Value/Cyclical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) BELOW TREND, DIS (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -12.44%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -11.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -10.11%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.59% | 1M: +5.58%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology and select Consumer names (EL notable further down).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND. Watch divergences: FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY and AAPL (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -8.85%) RECOVERY — short-term bounces, not confirmed trend flips.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is weak and broad-based; NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND. Recent negative news and outsized 1W losses signal distribution; sector acting as a source of downside.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are soft and largely BELOW TREND: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.43% | 1M: -5.93%) BELOW TREND. With Financials negative and Industrials negative, this amplifies the RISK-OFF read.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed but tilted weaker: JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -14.07%) BELOW TREND. Defensive bid in a few names (JNJ, PFE) is present but not broad enough to offset overall weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and Materials exposure (XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Growth names showing structural weakness (NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored; be selective due to narrow leadership and RISK-OFF backdrop.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND — continue to monitor momentum. BEARISH: META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND — downside risk remains.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +17.83%) showing clear leadership; Materials (1W: +4.91% | 1M: -6.36%) on strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.56% | 1M: -7.18%) and Financials (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -9.37%) — watch for further downside.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming near-term resistance would be required to neutralize downside momentum. AAPL (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -8.85%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through on this short-term bounce. JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize would reinforce Financials drag. XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND — sustained above recent highs would confirm Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+80): J&J Darzalex approval — JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY; price action partially confirms sentiment. GOOGL (+50): AI product headline — GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND; sentiment is positive but price is diverging (distribution).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-80): Major lawsuit headline — META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND; sentiment and sharp price decline confirm downside. GOOGL (-80): legal loss headline — GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND; dual headlines amplify risk. ORCL (-55): dividend concerns — ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) BELOW TREND; sentiment confirms weakness. MSFT (-45): price target cut — MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND; watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF; Value/Cyclical style favored given narrow Energy/Materials leadership. XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND and SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND remain key downside risks. Monitor legal/news-driven sentiment on GOOGL and META for further market spillover.
